summary: Best Buy's holiday campaign expands creator deals (MKBHD, Dude Perfect), opens a TikTok Shop storefront for creator tagging and adds shopping through ChatGPT.
Books-A-Million and Wordery posted only routine promos on X; other partners were quiet.

items.title: Best Buy is using football, TikTok creators and ChatGPT to get your holiday shopping dollars
items.why: A partner retailer is pushing creator selling into TikTok Shop and ChatGPT this holiday season.
